config.executionMode.description: Where to run the octavo command. On Windows, auto uses WSL (through wsl.exe) when WSL has a distribution, and runs directly on Windows otherwise.
config.executionMode.auto: Decide automatically: local inside Remote-WSL and on Linux / macOS; on Windows, wsl if WSL has a distribution, local otherwise
config.executionMode.local: Run octavo directly on this machine (Linux, macOS, inside Remote-WSL, or Windows itself)
config.executionMode.wsl: Run octavo inside WSL from Windows, through wsl.exe
config.wslDistro.description: Distribution name to pass to wsl.exe (for example Ubuntu). Empty uses the default distribution. Only used when executionMode is wsl.
config.command.description: The command to run. Leave it as 'octavo' if it is on your PATH; a full path works too (for example /home/you/octavo/bin/octavo).
config.configPath.description: Where octavo.config.py is, relative to the workspace root. Empty searches the workspace for it.
config.diagnosticsOnSave.description: Run checkbib every time a Markdown or .bib file is saved, and underline citation keys that do not exist.
config.defaultTargets.description: Formats to build without being asked every time by "Build…" (for example ["latex", "docx"]). Empty asks each time.
config.typstCommand.description: The command run by "Preview This Typst File". Leave the default if it is on your PATH; a full path works too.
config.typstAutoOpenPdf.description: Open the matching .pdf when "Preview This Typst File" starts. If the LaTeX Workshop extension is installed, its auto-refreshing PDF viewer is used (otherwise you just get a note).

config.previewLectureColumn.description: For lecture notes, what the third column of the preview shows. The first two are always the manuscript and the A4 handout; pick "none" for a two-column layout.
config.previewLectureColumn.slides: The deck for the session the cursor is in
config.previewLectureColumn.notes: The speaker script (typst-notes) — the same deck on A4 with ::: notes underneath
config.previewLectureColumn.none: Nothing — manuscript and one PDF only
